recurringPatterns.pattern: 'establishes X but cannot establish Y' hedge on nearly every piece of evidence, as second/third sentence and again as last
instances: Osteology can establish trauma, timing, and sometimes the likely direction or instrument of a wound. It cannot identify the social relationship between attacker and victim.
The map did not establish that every damaged site had been deliberately selected. It recorded the consequences as a civic problem requiring organized response.

recurringPatterns.pattern: Every chapter ends with a summary paragraph naming each case in sequence with one clause each, then restating the thesis
instances: Varna, Aşıklı Höyük, Abydos, and the Gebel el-Arak knife show inequality emerging through burial, household space, monumental labour, and prestige weapons...
Carthage shows a city erased and converted into a warning. Ashoka shows remorse entering public policy...

recurringPatterns.pattern: Symmetrical double-edge antithesis as the settled verdict on every institution
instances: A ration could support life and discipline labour at once.
Restraint and domination operated through the same arrangements.

recurringPatterns.pattern: Identical chapter architecture: artifact, three to four paired cases, named rival interpretation partly conceded then bounded by a change of unit, synthesis
instances: A rival interpretation begins from a powerful intuition: ordinary people are safer when a government is strong enough to prevent private violence.
A rival explanation claims that religious belief alone caused persecution...

recurringPatterns.pattern: 'remove X and Y fails' subtractive-mechanism paragraph in almost identical wording across chapters
instances: Remove doctrine and persecution loses its sacred object; remove jurisdiction and accusation may remain denunciation rather than sentence.
Remove credit and expansion becomes harder. Remove legal enslavement and the labor relation must be renegotiated.

summary: Conceptually serious, single sustained argument, strong closing engagement with the long-decline thesis; costs are pacing and shape: the central move repeated hundreds of times, chapters structurally interchangeable, mechanical recap then balanced aphorism; canonical examples with thin historiographical engagement.
